# Vendored: DVOACAP-Python

- Upstream: https://github.com/skyelaird/dvoacap-python
- Commit: 96f75a62c8db492f2916ad127cd6f3021941e967 (2026-05-01)
- Licence: MIT (LICENSE); attribution chain in NOTICE (DVOACAP by VE3NEA, MIT; VOACAP, public domain)
- Copied unchanged: `src/dvoacap/{prediction_engine,antenna_gain,fourier_maps,geomagnetic,ionospheric_profile,layer_parameters,muf_calculator,noise_model,path_geometry,reflectrix,solar}.py` and `src/dvoacap/DVoaData/`
- Left out: dashboard, `space_weather_sources.py` (network), `voacap_parser.py`, the package `__init__.py` (replaced by a docstring-only one)
- Reviewed before vendoring: no network, subprocess, eval/exec or file writes; reads only `DVoaData/*.dat`.

Usage notes (see `wx/sources/hf.py`):
- `snr_db` is per 1 Hz (dB-Hz, the VOACAP convention). Required SNRs are therefore set in dB-Hz:
  SSB 44, CW 24, FT8 13. Upstream's REQUIRED_SNR_PARAMETER_FIX.md suggests 10 dB for SSB, which mixes
  units and overstates openings by ~34 dB.
- The long-path model (> 7000 km) is a stub upstream; paths are kept under ~10 000 km.
- Deviative loss is a stub (zero) upstream.
- Upstream's "reference" outputs in SampleIO/ref_*.out are generated by the port itself (header
  "DVOACAP-PYTHON BASELINE"), so they are not an independent check.

Our own check against genuine VOACAP output (in upstream SampleIO/):
- Philadelphia–London, VOACAP Online, Nov, SSN 81, 80 W, 3° minimum angle: identical MUFs; SNR median
  error +2.3 dB, |error| median 7 dB, p90 24 dB; SSB/CW/FT8/closed category identical in 74 % of
  hour×band cells, off by more than one step in 4 %.
- Tangier–Belgrade, VOACAP 12.0722A, Jun, SSN 100, 0.1° minimum angle: identical MUFs, MUFday within
  ~0.05, losses within ~5 dB below the MUF, but 20–40 dB too high above it. Keep the 3° default.
